decisive_items: Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
response.rationale: Histopathology shows invasive proliferation of malignant squamous cells with mitoses, hyperkeratosis, and pseudohorn cysts, diagnostic of squamous cell carcinoma. No other candidate supplied.
